items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: who was that man that I used to see you study with in Boston? ... Andrew Jacobson. ... That guy showed me the secret... I had studied from Merle... Jacobson said, 'All you got to do when you make your attack is let your tongue relax.'

ctx.x: Now, who was that man that I used to see you study with in Boston?
Jacobson. Across from Symphony Hall, right?
